summary: The reconciler's full pass, which re-checks every settled item, runs every five minutes instead of every half hour, because some work is still reached only by a full pass

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: Incremental passes are unchanged. Work that only a full pass reaches, such as a loop timeout, an LLM gate's time limit, trust-prompt recovery, rendered files put back on disk, or an exec gate after a pending gate, happens within five minutes again instead of up to thirty. The profile still notes each full pass and each correction it makes.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an older build restores its spacing: half an hour on builds since the half-hourly change, about a minute before it.
